title: Roasted Potatoes

items.item: onion soup mix (a good amount, sprinkled)
garlic, hot paprika, Jerusalem spice, cumin, coriander, and black pepper (sprinkled to taste)

instructions: Cut the potatoes into smaller pieces.
Put the potatoes on a baking tray.
Sprinkle a good amount of onion soup mix over the potatoes.
Sprinkle garlic, hot paprika, Jerusalem spice, cumin, coriander, and black pepper over the potatoes.
Cover the potatoes with a drizzle of oil (2-3 tablespoons).
Roast for 30 minutes and check with a fork to see if done.
